findings.rule: 274-c8; I.1 truth (profile holds only what the user stated)
findings.trigger: Fill in myself, type title 'Busines Analyst' / 'Infosys', Continue. ManualProfileRoute uses navigator.navigate (push), so back from Review returns to the same Manual view model with its state. Fix the typo to 'Business Analyst', Continue again: SaveManualProfileUseCase keeps every existing entry and appends a second USER_STATED, isConfirmed=true role with a new id. The profile now holds two confirmed roles, one with the typo, both sendable to tailoring.
findings.title: Continue after returning from Review appends a duplicate confirmed role instead of replacing the one this screen added
findings.proof: ManualProfileViewModelTest: onContinue with jobTitle 'Busines Analyst', await Saved, change jobTitle to 'Business Analyst', onContinue again, assert the saved profile has exactly one EXPERIENCE entry titled 'Business Analyst'.

findings.rule: 274-c3 counts from the parsed profile; I.1 nothing claimed that was not found
findings.trigger: A resume with one role that has 20 bullets: both parsers split it through splitBulletsForEntries into two EXPERIENCE entries (15 + 5) where the second continues() the first. Reading shows '2 roles' for one role.
findings.title: Work experience count treats a split continuation entry as another role
findings.proof: ReadingViewModelTest: parser returns two EXPERIENCE entries with identical title/organization/dates; assert the Experience row count is 1.

findings.rule: 274-c5 (a file over 5 MB lands on Unreadable with the size copy)
findings.trigger: Pick a 7 MB DOCX from a provider whose cursor returns null SIZE: measure() gives 0, the size gate passes, toByteArrayLimited stops at 5 MB + 1 byte and the truncated bytes are parsed. The result is either a partial import or 'image only' copy, never the 'bigger than 5 MB' copy. Pre-existing reader, but this PR lowers the limit and claims c5 for over-limit files.
findings.title: Over-limit file with unknown size is truncated and parsed instead of mapped to TooLarge
findings.proof: Robolectric provider with null SIZE serving RESUME_READ_LIMIT_BYTES + 10 bytes; assert read() returns ResumeRead.TooLarge.

findings.rule: D40 (never break inside a word; a single word shrinks to the 1x floor first)
findings.trigger: Reading or Unreadable at 337dp, font 2.0, file 'PriyaDeshmukhResume2026.pdf': the name is a plain Text in strongLarge with break opportunities only after _ . - /, no whole-word shrink, so 'PriyaDeshmukhResume2026.' breaks mid-word. The baselines use 'Priya_Deshmukh_Resume.pdf', which hides it. The same PR fixed the identical case for the email with TmrFitText.
findings.title: File-card name breaks inside a word for names without separators
